quests.title: Echoes of a Forsaken Song

dialogue.t: That's such a weird instrument... No matter how Paimon plucks it, there's not a single sound! Is it broken?

dialogue.sit: Huh? But I definitely heard music just now. And singing...

dialogue.t: Yeah, forget the instrument for now. Just follow the Seelie up, and we'll probably find the treasure!

quests.description: It seems that many Seelie are gathering at the center of Amsvartnir…
